_doc: Comparator switches Mahmood has SIGNED (harness/served_comparator.switch_signed; scripts/render_g1_tracker.comparator_switch). A served page names its previous comparator until its switch is here as SEEN_AND_SIGNED with exactly that from -> to. Each signature names the bytes the reviewer saw: the packet file's sha256 and the sha256 of that item's section in it.
